The necklace features a twisted wire chain (likely copper or bronze) and a large, circular, flat pendant. The pendant has a pale green/teal background with a raised, embroidered-style design of a pink/magenta butterfly or moth in the center. A silver-colored bail connects the pendant to the chain.
